# Resto by Arkadya
> Restaurant websites for restaurants in Thailand, by Arkadya (Thai Online Solutions Co., Ltd.). 3,900 THB one-time. A standard site can go live in as little as 2 days once we have the menu, opening hours and photos; extra features or integrations can take longer.

## Key facts
- Price: 3,900 THB, paid once (the site shows a regular price of 6,000 THB).
- The package lists: a custom restaurant website, English / French / Thai versions, table booking with WhatsApp confirmation, a digital menu (photos or items), Google Maps and local SEO basics, mobile-first design, 0% commission on direct bookings.
- After launch, price, dish and opening-hour changes are handled through WhatsApp.
- Free audit of your current digital presence, and a free preview at https://food.arkadya.tech
- Contact: WhatsApp +66 88 687 5964, Line "Thai Onlinesolutions", hello@arkadya.tech
